name: perttool
description: Document-based PERT/CPM and resource scheduling CLI

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && npm run build --workspace perttool-language-server-private && npm run build --workspace perttool-vscode-private && npm run build --workspace perttool-mcp-private
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm run typecheck --workspace perttool-language-server-private && npm run typecheck --workspace perttool-vscode-private && npm run typecheck --workspace perttool-mcp-private
scripts.check:static: npm run typecheck && npm run check:duplication && npm run check:complexity
scripts.check: npm run check:static && npm test && npm run check:english && npm run check:docs && npm run check:self-use && npm run check:lsp-package && npm run check:mcp-package && npm run check:vsix-shell && npm run check:link && npm run check:package
